channel.title: eNews Channel Africa - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from eNews Channel Africa (enca.com)

item.title: US social media addiction trial jury struggles for consensus
item.description: Jurors resume deliberations in a landmark social media trial after signalling that they were having trouble agreeing when it comes to one of the two defendants, Meta and YouTube.

item.title: Bill Cosby ordered to pay $19m over sex abuse claim
item.description: A woman who said she was drugged and sexually assaulted by veteran US entertainer Bill Cosby was awarded more than $19-million on Monday after a civil hearing in California.

item.title: 'My sister suffered' | How angels of health became merchants of death
item.description: The Health Ombud report found shocking treatment of mental health patients.

item.title: AKA's father slams Madlanga Commission for airing footage of son's murder
item.description: The father of slain South African hip hop star Kiernan “AKA” Forbes has slammed the Madlanga Commission for airing footage of his son’s killing.

item.title: Mozambique might reach 'gas cliff', Sasol has a solution
item.description: Gas supplies from Mozambique's Pande and Tamane fields are nearing decline. The 'gas cliff' is expected to arrive by by 2028, but Sasol says they have a solution.

item.title: UPDATE: State opposes bail for Matlala
item.description: Twelve senior police officials and a company director arrested for corruption in Pretoria will appear in court on Wednesday.

item.title: Voices Of Change | When rights fail in practice
item.description: Heidi Giokos speaks to Celest Louw from the TEARS Foundation about women’s rights, children’s rights, and the devastating gap between legal protection and lived protection in South Africa.

item.title: Summons for top cop Fannie Masemola
item.description: Police have confirmed that National Police Commissioner General Fannie Masemola has been served with a summons to appear in court.

item.title: 12 police officers granted bail in tender corruption case
item.description: Accused number one, alleged criminal kingpin Vusimuzi 'Cat' Matlala, will remain behind bars.

item.title: 'Nothing to hide' - Mashatile willing to appear at Madlanga Commission
item.description: Deputy President Paul Mashatile will present himself before the Madlanga Commission if called, in a bid to clear his name.

item.title: 'No one is above law' - Govt on arrest of 12 cops in alleged tender corruption case
item.description: Government says the arrest of police officers accused of corruption shows that no one is above the law.

item.title: Ramaphosa breaks silence on Masemola
item.description: President Cyril Ramaphosa says he has noted the decision to charge Masemola.

item.title: Trump names tech titans to science advisory council
item.description: President Donald Trump on Wednesday named some of the biggest names in US technology to his Council of Advisors on Science and Technology, assembling a roster that includes Meta founder Mark Zuckerberg and Google co-founder Sergey Brin.

item.title: Tehran receives US plan to end Mideast war, as Iran fires at US carrier
item.description: Iran has received a 15-point plan from the United States to end the Middle East war, Pakistani officials said Wednesday, raising hopes for a diplomatic solution even as Iran said it had fired a volley of cruise missiles at a US aircraft carrier.

item.title: US ski star Shiffrin wins overall World Cup title for sixth time
item.description: US ski star Mikaela Shiffrin held off Emma Aicher to wrap up the overall World Cup title for a sixth time after Wednesday's season-ending giant slalom.
